note: Draft, for review. The first full install, end to end: from 'install Jupylet' in the code folder to the spaceship running. It starts after the download and the move to the code folder, because the skills appearing at the end of a turn can only be tested in a real session. The persona and the system come from simulators/personas and simulators/systems; their checks are added to the checks below. max_actions is per worker turn.
request:
Sam downloaded the Jupylet code with Claude a moment ago, and the chat now works in the folder {code}. Sam's first message: 'ok, the code is downloaded. can you install jupylet now?'.

Sam says yes to each step that Claude proposes for the installation: Miniforge, the Terminal settings, the environment, the installation of Jupylet, trusting the notebooks, and opening the spaceship example. Before the yes to the Terminal settings, Sam asks one question, if Claude did not already answer it: 'can I undo that later?'.

When Claude asks Sam to paste a token into the page, Sam does it, in a <do>, with the exact token that Claude gave. If Claude offers to hide the list of chats, Sam says yes. If Claude then asks whether to remember that, Sam says yes.

The session ends when Claude says that the spaceship example runs and how to use it: Sam clicks the canvas, presses the arrow keys in a <do>, says thanks, and ends. If Claude offers to show how to start Jupylet without Claude, Sam says 'maybe later, thanks'. If something goes wrong and Claude stops, Sam ends.
